motivation: E46 restores correct edge evidence but measured +9.5ms median confirmation in a fixed AVD workload. A pre-change 56-state hash-selected pilot observes 1770597 boundary lookups and 411297 distinct pairs summed per state; repetition is real but not a latency attribution.
hypotheses: Repeated immutable character-pair lookups across paths and spelling routes are avoidable without changing boundary attenuation or floating arithmetic.
Fixed primitive storage may cost less than additional per-edge maps and boxed keys; allocation and collisions still need device measurement.
Reduced calls alone may fail on ART, as E41 demonstrated for another memo; keep only an actual paired latency nonregression with exact outputs.
candidate: One lazy query-local direct-mapped cache of raw immutable bigram scores, owned by the existing query-local scorer. 1024 slots for raw queries shorter than 12 letters, otherwise 8192 slots. No parameter grid or repeat to select noise. Two primitive arrays, pair identity checked on every hit; collision replaces only after successful lookup. Invalid Unicode code points bypass memo. Compound scaling remains outside memo.

scope: Execution-cost optimization after a correctness fix, not an accuracy gain. Preserve rc.5 and physical-phone boundary; overall goal remains active.
